chunks.text: Most items can be returned within 30 days of purchase for a full refund, as long as they are unused and in their original packaging. Please bring your receipt or order number.
Sale and clearance items may be returned within 14 days for store credit only. Bikes that have been ridden outdoors cannot be returned, but can be exchanged within 7 days.
We offer free local delivery of assembled bikes within 25 miles of our Midtown store, including Germantown, Bartlett, Cordova and Southaven. Deliveries are scheduled Tuesday through Saturday.
Online orders can be returned by mail using the prepaid label included in the box, or dropped off in store. Refunds are issued to the original payment method within 5 business days of receipt.
All new bikes include a lifetime frame warranty from the manufacturer against defects in materials and workmanship. Components such as brakes, chains and tires are covered for one year.
A basic tune-up is $75 and includes brake and gear adjustment, wheel truing and a safety check. Most tune-ups are completed within 2 business days. New bikes get one free tune-up within 90 days.
Midtown Cycle Co. is open Tuesday to Friday 10am-7pm, Saturday 9am-5pm and Sunday 12pm-4pm. We are closed on Mondays and major holidays.
We sell road, mountain, hybrid and kids' bikes, plus e-bikes from two brands. We also carry helmets, locks, lights and apparel, and offer professional bike fittings by appointment.

questions.question: How long do I have to return something?
questions.answer: You can return most items within 30 days of purchase for a full refund, as long as they're unused and in the original packaging - just bring your receipt or order number [returns-1]. Sale and clearance items have a shorter 14-day window and are refunded as store credit [returns-2].

questions.question: Can I return a sale item I bought online?
questions.answer: Yes. Sale items can be returned within 14 days, but the refund is issued as store credit rather than to your card [returns-2]. Since you ordered online, you can mail it back with the prepaid label from your box or drop it off at the store [shipping-2].

questions.question: Is my bike's frame covered under warranty?
questions.answer: Yes - every new bike comes with a lifetime manufacturer warranty on the frame covering defects in materials and workmanship. Parts like brakes, chains and tires are covered for one year [warranty-1].

questions.question: How much is a tune-up and how long does it take?
questions.answer: A basic tune-up is $75 and covers brake and gear adjustment, wheel truing and a safety check. Most are finished within 2 business days. If you bought your bike new from us, your first tune-up within 90 days is free [warranty-2].

questions.question: Do you deliver to Germantown?
questions.answer: Yes! Germantown is within our free local delivery area. We deliver assembled bikes within 25 miles of the Midtown store, Tuesday through Saturday [shipping-1].

questions.question: Do you sell electric scooters?
questions.answer: I don't have any information about electric scooters in our store documents, so I don't want to guess. I can connect you with a team member who can help - would you like me to do that?
